$comment: Model roles for the social media agent. No secrets here: keys are referenced by env var name (apiKeyEnv / credentialsEnv) and live in .env. Override per role with LLM_<ROLE>_MODEL / LLM_<ROLE>_BASE_URL, e.g. LLM_TOOL_CALLING_MODEL. thinking: default (provider decides) | disabled (required for forced tool calls) | enabled | adaptive.
